4 of 7 members present. Quorum established.

Agenda
Item 1
Anti-Hedging and Pledging Policy Review

The committee discussed the Anti-Hedging and Pledging Policy Review, a review of the company's compliance with the Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX). The committee reviewed the company's internal controls over financial reporting and confirmed that they were effective.

Item 2
Brand and Reputation Risk Assessment

The committee reviewed the Brand and Reputation Risk Assessment, a proposal to enter the 12 market. The discussion focused on the competitive landscape and the regulatory hurdles. The committee approved a budget for a feasibility study.

Motion

To approve for transformation: RESOLVED, that the Enterprise Risk Management Committee recommends the appointment of Northgate Partners as the company's independent registered public accounting firm for the fiscal year ending 1985-01-01.

Moved: Angus Neal  •  Seconded: Roscoe Ayoola
Vote: 4 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 3
Foreign Exchange Hedging Policy Review

The committee considered the Foreign Exchange Hedging Policy Review, a proposal to acquire Northgate Partners. The discussion was held in executive session. Upon returning to open session, the Chair announced that the committee had authorized management to submit a non-binding letter of intent.

Motion

To approve for brand equity: RESOLVED, that the Enterprise Risk Management Committee approves the company's response to the shareholder proposal regarding Foreign Exchange Hedging Policy Review.

Moved: Sigrid Do  •  Seconded: Lucille Prasetyo
Vote: 4 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 4
Product Strategy and Roadmap for 1985

The committee considered the Product Strategy and Roadmap for 1985, a proposal to adopt a new policy on charitable contributions. The policy was approved and will be implemented company-wide.

Motion

To approve for sustainable growth: RESOLVED, that the Enterprise Risk Management Committee endorses the strategic framework for the Product Strategy and Roadmap for 1985 and directs management to develop a detailed implementation plan for review at the next meeting.

Moved: Angus Neal  •  Seconded: Sigrid Do
Vote: 4 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
